_doc: Candidate figures — present on disk + valid science but NOT currently in the paper .tex. Houston picks which to re-add via the paper detail page gallery. Each candidate ordinal starts at 100 to avoid colliding with in-paper figures (1..N).

paper-1a.alt: Effect of bounce-era cosmic rotation on the expansion history
paper-1a.title: Rotation × Expansion
paper-1a.desc: Distance-impact of a residual cosmic rotation component on the Hubble expansion. Visualizes the (ω/H)_0 < 5×10⁻¹¹ Saadeh+2016 isotropy bound and the consequent suppression of any direct rotation signature in the late-time Hubble flow.

paper-1a.alt: Parameter naturalness window across the four ECH routes
paper-1a.title: Naturalness window (4-route map)
paper-1a.desc: Position of each of the four minimal Einstein–Cartan–Holst dark-energy routes in the (coupling × mass) plane against the natural-parameter window. Visualizes why the closure rests on cosmological-constant-class tuning at m_θ ~ H_0 rather than amplitude mismatch alone.

paper-1a.alt: Observational decision timeline for the surviving ECH tests
paper-1a.title: Observational timeline
paper-1a.desc: Timeline of survey decisions (CMB-S4, LiteBIRD, SPHEREx, DESI DR2) that could falsify or confirm the surviving mechanism-independent ECH signatures (f_NL = -35/8 matter-bounce + spectator-ALP birefringence).

paper-1a.alt: Detection forecast for the 2 surviving ECH tests
paper-1a.title: Surviving-test detection forecast
paper-1a.desc: Detection-significance forecast for the matter-bounce f_NL = -35/8 SPHEREx window + the spectator-ALP birefringence LiteBIRD window. Connects the no-go theorem of §sec:barriers to the surviving falsification paths in §sec:surviving.

paper-1b.alt: NaMaster β recovery vs HEALPix NSIDE
paper-1b.title: NaMaster β recovery vs NSIDE
paper-1b.desc: Pipeline-recovery test of injected birefringence β across NSIDE = {256, 512, 1024} at f_sky = 0.32. Demonstrates the recovery floor + SNR-on-mean scaling that anchors the §IV.A SNR = 20.3 claim.

paper-1b.alt: ΔN_eff posterior viability across three frozen dataset combinations
paper-1b.title: ΔN_eff posterior — three frozen runs
paper-1b.desc: Joint 1D + 2D ΔN_eff posterior across the full-tension (Planck+SH0ES), Planck+BAO+SN, and Planck-only frozen MCMC chains. The 309,789-sample evidence anchors the §IV ΔN_eff ≈ 0 null-consistency conclusion.

paper-1b.title: ΔN_eff two-chain overlay
paper-1b.desc: Overlay of the two converged frozen chains (full-tension + Planck+BAO+SN) showing how the H_0 — ΔN_eff degeneracy direction differs by dataset. Useful for showing the inverse-variance combination assumption discussion.

paper-2.alt: Four-vertex amplitude diagram for spectator-ALP × matter-bounce coupling
paper-2.title: 4-vertex amplitude sum
paper-2.desc: Tree-level vertex sum for the spectator-ALP × matter-bounce coupling channels. Diagrammatic intuition for the f_a cancellation in the rotation amplitude β.

paper-2.alt: Spectator-ALP β comparison vs Eskilt+ data
paper-2.title: ALP β vs Eskilt+2022
paper-2.desc: Spectator-ALP β = 0.342° ± 0.094° posterior overlay vs the published joint Planck+ACT Eskilt+2022 measurement. Visualizes the consistency check anchored at f_a = M_Pl, m = H_0.

paper-2.title: ALP MCMC triangle
paper-2.desc: Triangle plot for the (θ_i, m_θ, C_aγ, β) posterior on the spectator-ALP joint chain. Shows the parameter degeneracies + the natural-prior box boundary discussion.

paper-3.title: Anomaly sky distribution
paper-3.desc: Mollweide all-sky distribution of the 14,089 high-confidence DESI + cross-survey anomalies. Color-coded by anomaly score + class. Useful as a hero map alongside the §III architecture figure.

paper-3.alt: Photometric redshift scatter for P3 anomaly catalog
paper-3.title: Photo-z scatter
paper-3.desc: Photo-z vs spectro-z scatter for the P3 anomaly catalog (DESI + cross-matched DR8 + UNIONS). Anchors the photo-z residual quality cut in §III.B.

paper-3.title: Photo-z residuals
paper-3.desc: Residual distribution (Δz / (1+z)) for the photo-z calibration sample. Used to justify the catastrophic-outlier cut at |Δz/(1+z)| > 0.15.

paper-3.alt: f_NL constraint improvement from P3 anomaly removal
paper-3.title: f_NL improvement from anomaly removal
paper-3.desc: σ(f_NL) improvement as a function of P3 anomaly-removal threshold. Quantifies the load-bearing claim that the catalog reduces f_NL contamination for SPHEREx-class surveys.

paper-3.alt: NanoGrav γ_GWB fit on the P3-cleaned sample
paper-3.title: NanoGrav γ_GWB fit
paper-3.desc: NanoGrav 15yr γ_GWB MAP fit after applying the P3 anomaly catalog to the host-galaxy environment. Anchors the §V γ = 3.0 cross-reference.

paper-3.alt: NEOWISE ecliptic distribution of Path-C anomalies
paper-3.title: Path-C NEOWISE ecliptic
paper-3.desc: Ecliptic-coordinate distribution of NEOWISE Path-C native-retrieval anomalies. Shows the residual ecliptic concentration after de-duplication — used to justify the §III.E ecliptic-systematic discussion.

paper-3.alt: Per-pixel anomaly rate map across all 6 surveys
paper-3.title: Anomaly rate sky map
paper-3.desc: Per-pixel anomaly rate (anomalies / spectra) across all 6 surveys. Visualizes the survey-depth × anomaly-rate correlation discussed in §III.D.

paper-3.title: Survey depth map
paper-3.desc: Per-pixel maximum-z reached by each survey in the P3 catalog. Companion to the anomaly-rate map for diagnosing systematic vs astrophysical anomalies.

paper-3.alt: Survey depth vs anomaly rate scatter
paper-3.title: Depth × rate scatter
paper-3.desc: Scatter of per-pixel anomaly rate against survey depth. Quantitative anchor for the depth-coupling systematic discussion in §III.D.

paper-3.alt: UMAP embedding colored by anomaly score
paper-3.title: UMAP × anomaly score
paper-3.desc: 2D UMAP embedding of the encoder latent space, colored by per-spectrum anomaly score. Hero figure for the §II.A representation-learning approach.

paper-3.title: UMAP × redshift
paper-3.desc: Same UMAP embedding colored by spectroscopic redshift. Visualizes how the encoder organizes spectra by z without explicit redshift supervision.

paper-3.alt: UMAP embedding colored by spectral type
paper-3.title: UMAP × spectral type
paper-3.desc: Same UMAP embedding colored by DESI primary spectroscopic class (GALAXY/STAR/QSO). Shows native class separation in the unsupervised latent.

paper-4.alt: Template-overlap robustness sweep for P4 chirality dipole
paper-4.title: Template-overlap robustness
paper-4.desc: Sweep of the 9-template nuisance basis overlap parameter (correlation between primordial-dipole basis and depth/density templates). Anchors the §IV.D nuisance-marginalized fit robustness claim.

paper-5.title: f_CW vs z
paper-5.desc: Equivariant CW fraction as a function of redshift across the DESI DR1 footprint. Visualizes the z-stratified null check that the chirality-environment signal is z-independent.

paper-5.title: P5 sky footprint
paper-5.desc: Mollweide footprint of the P5 DESI×DESIVAST environmental analysis (56,981 void spirals + 791,635 cross-matched DR1 spirals). Useful as a context map.

paper-5.alt: P5 redshift histogram by environment class
paper-5.title: z histogram by environment
paper-5.desc: Redshift histogram of the P5 sample stratified by V-Web/T-Web environment class (void / wall / filament / knot). Anchors the sample-balance discussion.

paper-5.title: Confidence sensitivity
paper-5.desc: Sensitivity of the P5 per-environment Δf_CW signal to the equivariant confidence threshold p_eq cut. Quantifies the robustness of the headline result across p_eq ∈ [0.6, 0.95].

paper-5.title: Radius sensitivity
paper-5.desc: Sensitivity of the per-environment Δf_CW signal to the DESIVAST void-radius cut. Anchors the §VI robustness check that the signal is not driven by a specific void size.

paper-5.alt: P5 CW vs cosmic-web local density
paper-5.title: f_CW vs local density
paper-5.desc: Equivariant CW fraction as a function of cosmic-web local density (V-Web density-quintile classification). Companion to the per-environment bar chart, showing the continuous trend.

paper-5.title: HEALPix CW residual
paper-5.desc: Per-pixel residual Δf_CW^eq after subtracting the V-Web environmental prediction. Visualizes spatial coherence of the residual + supports the §VII null-systematic discussion.
